_comment: Known divergence between LinkCard_Promoter_App_Expo and LinkCard_Event_Admin_App_Expo design tokens. This is a SNAPSHOT OF DEBT, not a whitelist of acceptable divergence: every entry should be resolved, and pruning an entry tightens the guard. Entries are normalised line fingerprints (whitespace collapsed, trailing semicolon stripped); see scripts/compare-tokens.mjs. The 24 entries below group into: 4 tokens present only in Promoter (none / buttonHeightSm / iconBox / skeletonRows), 1 token whose VALUE differs (tabBarHeight 56 vs 52), and 19 lines that exist only because Promoter also exports a theme aggregate plus fontFamily and elevation. Run `node scripts/compare-tokens.mjs --verbose` to see them against the source.
